reviews.text: Awesome. Vet is transparent about charges and take LA city spay and neuter vouchers. Saves you a lot of money! Get there early.

Brought in  two dogs in for a spay and neuter.  I asked Dr Vasquez if the incision was going to be large on my female because my dog had gained weight and was pretty rotund and I was worried that she would have a ten inch incision like my last dog.  He immediately answered: “the incision will be appropriate for the surgery”.  A very smart answer!
The incision ended up being really small, like less than two inches in my 35 lb dog.  The office is modern and bright, exceptionally clean, and the team there is courteous, excellent and the office is efficiently run.  Had to wait for check in and pick up but had an interesting time chatting with the other clients and their pets.

Quite a long wait, but was still definitely worth it, and our dog got a little training on how to wait around other animals. The doctor here is great and you can tell the staff just wants to make sure you feel heard and seen regarding your pets issues. They are also hustling, like it was a lot of people, but they were getting through everyone for sure. The pricing wasn’t too bad either and they take city vouchers. Definitely more affordable than VCA if you’re wondering and it felt like we were taking home everything we really needed for our dog.
Dr. J. Vasquez is the best!!! Great staff!!!

Dr Vasquez and his staff are exceptional. They went above and beyond, caring for Nala (beagle -lab) for an eye infection. Dr Vasquez is highly informed, efficient, offering the utmost professionalism. Since Dr Vasquez offers his services for low income. There is a 3 to 4 hour wait to be seen. Regardless of financial circumstances, Dr Vasquez is the only vet I trust with the care of my pups. He is personable and generous. Thank you for a truly wonderful experience Xo
Best vet in SoCal. Usually 1/3rd the price if any other vet. However.  Make sure they are open. Only takes 1st 50 people.  Be there by 6 am!!
Always bring my pets here
Excellent service, reasonable prices, $20 per vaccine. You just have to reserve your spot starting at 6:00 AM because they only serve 50 people. I recommend this hospital.
These people are all angels and love your pets as much as you do.

It's a very good hospital where they treat pets well. They operated on my three dogs, Galleta, Chikee, and Lolita. The prices are reasonable, but you have to get there early because they only see the first 50 people. I recommend it 😉

They are the best. I have been going to them for 7 years now and I can’t imagine going anywhere else. Dr. Joey is kind, patience, and extremely knowledgeable. His entire team is very professional and friendly.

Great vet with highly qualified personnel. Specialize in spay, neuter, vaccines.
Pleasant atmosphere with waiting area and parking. Prices are reasonable.
Thank you so much , I had a very great experience today. Dr. Vasquez is very professional, humble and kind.
They will kill your pet. Worst place on earth. We waited for four hours until we could get our cat vaccinated. They marked us as completed and just brushed us off. One of the worst places on earth.

Best animal hospital we’ve been to.

The place was under renovations when we visited but you can already tell it’s going to be really nice and modern.

Heads up, we did a walk in and waited about 2 hours before being seen, so plan for that. But once we were called in, things moved quickly. They did a weight check and the doctor came in shortly after.

The doctor was so friendly and created such a calm environment. You could feel the empathy and care, which helped us not feel anxious about our dog’s pain. She immediately reassured us that our dog was okay, just a sprain from her high intensity zoomies.

Payment took a while but shorter than being seen, but honestly? Still the best animal hospital we’ve been to. We’re officially switching to this one. Highly recommend!
Very helpful and friendly staff

The early wake up and arrival is worth it to get on the list and experience a kind, efficient and empathetic staff and affordable care for your beloved pet. Bonus is that you get to spend the morning surrounded by other animal lovers. Bring a camping chair and a coffee for the wait and you’re set.

Dr. Joey is the BEST!! Couldn't trust any veterinarian with my babies more😻 Highly recommend!! ONLY downside is how early you have to get there and wait in line because it's only a walk in clinic and they only see the first 50 people who sign up. But even WITH that, this is the best place to bring your fur angels, and they are INSANELY reasonable with their pricing... truly keeping the business human♡

I came here but was turned away because my dog has melanoma.  They wouldn't see her for palliative cancer care whatsoever. I can't afford to get her proper cancer treatment like chemo, or to be seen anywhere for a basic exam, but I would have at  liked to not watch her suffer and die slowly. I don't understand why this hospital can't offer basic pain care for all animals- an X-ray, biopsy, or even options for euthanasia. Nothing at all just because of her diagnosis. It's very cruel.

This place is great, a salvation for folks who might have have to resources to get their pets cared for at other facilities.

You have to show up early, (before 7am, Tuesday-Saturday,) to get on the sign-up list. They only serve the first 50 people that sign up each day. Be prepared to wait up to 5 hours. But Dr. Joey his staff are doing great work, and are a true asset to this community.

I am currently underemployed, and when I took my cat to the vet, they quoted more than $1500 to have a growth removed. I simply could not afford that. I heard about NFAH from a friend, and they were able to perform the surgery (with biopsy and removal of stitches weeks later) for about half as much.

I am grateful that this place and these people are here, working hard with compassion, week after week and year after year.

Thank you Dr. Joey and all the folks at NFAH!

Did a good job taking care of my dog found out what was wrong with no problem it was cheap gave her her medicine and she's doing fine

It's very good, but very expensive… I went from East LA because I thought it would be a bit cheaper, but their prices are quite high. The only way to save is to go to Life for Pets; they cover the costs, but you have to make an appointment with them, and they're the ones who pay. Compared to other places, their prices are very high. You have to arrive at 6:00 AM, and they only attend to the first 50 people.
Thank you for seeing our kitty Mac!! Appreciate all that you do for so many animals (and their parents!) Don’t know what we’d all do without organizations like you 🧡 …

This place has their own system of seeing the first 50 animals in line, starting a sign in sheet at 730am. I went one time before and was too late, arriving at 7, so the next time I was there by 630 and was seen after 2 1/2 hours, which wasn't a bad time to wait. I had to return at 430 to pick up my cat. Had a voucher for a spay surgery, which was honored, and I had to get my cat vaccinations in order to get the spay surgery, so I paid $128 in total.

I want to take a moment to thank Dr. Vasquez and the team for the care and compassion they gave to my cat during her spay surgery. Unfortunately, we lost her due to a severe and undetected diaphragmatic hernia, but I am truly grateful for the time and effort Dr. put in to try and save her.

He not only performed the surgery but stayed with her through the night, doing everything he could—including resuscitation and emergency support—trying to give her a chance. His dedication and heart did not go unnoticed.

Even in the hardest moments, I could feel that he truly cared. Losing her has been incredibly painful, but I have peace knowing she was in good hands and surrounded by people who tried their best.

Thank you, Dr, Vasquez for treating her with compassion, and for your honesty and care. It means the world to me.

Sincerely,
Susana garcia

I'm usually not one to write reviews, but I feel compelled to share my experience with this office. My dog requires seizure medication and needs to check in every 30 days. However, last week I called for his monthly refill only to find out the entire office was closed for a week without any notification. I had to wait until the following Tuesday to get his medication, which his life depends on.

When I called, the front staff seemed unbothered and unconcerned about my dog's urgent needs, citing they were still catching up on work after their break. Despite explaining the importance of the medication, they showed no empathy or understanding.

This experience made me realize I need to find a new vet. While Dr. Vasquez may be a good doctor, the poor service and lack of care from his office staff aren't worth it. If you're looking for affordable clinics in LA, I encourage you to do your research and find a place that truly cares about you and your pet.

I've been visiting this beautiful veterinary clinic for 17 years. The services are wonderful, you just have to go early, around 6 or 7 AM, because they only accept 50 dogs. I love all the nurses and the doctor. May God always bless them all.

Dr Vasquez is amazing his staff is truly wonderful The facility is beautiful You couldn't ask for a better place to take your babies Rosie will be forever grateful to Dr Vasquez and his staff and so will I Thank you for taking such great care of Rosie she healed up beautifully and is doing great she is now going to get her chance to have a beautiful life Thank you guys so much❤️🐾

I'd been looking for a low-cost clinic after being quoted up to $2k for anesthetic dental cleaning for my chihuahua mix at my typical vet. I am beyond pleased with my experience at this clinic - organization, professionalism, and price were exceptional.

I showed up at 5:30am on a Thursday and was 3rd in line. Not too many people showed up today. They opened the gate for us to sign in in the same order we made line around 6:30am, then proceeded to seated waiting area in their parking lot. I was called in for intake around 7:15am. Since my dog is a senior, Doctor did a quick physical and asked if I wanted to do a blood exam (due to her age and anesthesia) (also - if you do want/need blood work, you'd have to come back a different day for the dental cleaning because they have to send the blood to the labs). I declined the blood work, and doctor provided the final price upfront before the service. They even showed me the kennel where my dog would recover. Pick up was at 4:30pm, you also have to sign in for pickup on a sheet. Pickup took around 30 min - you get called in to pay and get instructions about any meds/recovery for your pet, then a few min later a vet tech comes out with your pet and repeats any instructions.

The lack of appointment system and having to show up early is not for everyone, but it is definitely worth it if you're able to, at least for high-cost procedures.

Dr. Vazquez is great. He’s super knowledgeable and from my experience always looks for what best for your pet, without trying to price gouge you. He cares. While the front office is not always as approachable, his assistants are helpful and nice.

This vet takes the first 50 clients of the day in the morning as first come first serve. I got in line on the sidewalk at 5:50am and was 6th in line but 20 minutes later the line was already around the block. Around 6:45am they opened the gate and I was able to sign in and take a seat in their waiting area in the parking lot. They called my name for intake around 7:10am. My dog was having dental surgery so I came back for pickup at 4pm. You sign in for pickup too. They’ll call your name over the speaker when it’s your turn and you’ll go inside to check out. Then you wait once more to see your dog with a tech before you go home. Checking out took about an hour all together. There is a small lot in the back for parking but it doesn’t open until they open the gate which is after the line starts. In the evening it was full, so I just parked on the adjacent street for free with no issue finding a spot.

The front staff is rude & unprofessional. I've worked in veterinarian hospitals before & do not recommend this place. This place is like a county hospital for animals. The prices may be cheap, walk in only but not worth it. Please consider Vca's, Eagle Glen, Mohawk in EP.  The front desk treatment will tell you alot about your pets treatment.

I will mention what most of these reviews are neglecting to say. You will wait for a minimum of 4 hours here because they only take walk-in signups. Must come and wait in line before 6:00am if you want your dog/cat to be seen the first hour. They only take the first 50 signups and by the time you get there the first 30 are your die hard pet lovers and abuelas who came 2 hours before you. I arrived at 7:30am and was the very last person. You will wait in line for two hours just to be one of the first 50 to sign-up. They open signups at 7am too. You have to skip brushing your own teeth and get to this hospital super early. You have been warned. Doctor and staff are excellent but (just like a Disneyland ride) you will wait hours but will get no more than 5 minutes w the doctor as they are “very busy”. Just wish they can invest in waitlist apps like on Yelp or change to appointment based. This system of making everyone wait is antiquated and not efficient. Prices are very fair and cheap compared to other hospitals. They don’t take appointments.  They have plastic chairs, metal folding chairs, and shade cover but if you are coming after 7am I highly suggest to pack your cup of coffee, some conchas, your Takis, snacks and water for your poochie, and an adult diaper for your 3-4 hour wait. For this reason I no longer take my dogs to this hospital. It’s gotten ridiculous and all that needs to be done is to change their system to appointment based. Locals to this neighborhood including stay-at-home dog moms and abuelas are the only ones who are willing to sacrifice their whole morning to get their dogs/cats checked here. Because it is the cheapest veterinarian hospital in town that people wait for 4-6 hours. I have been going to this hospital for as long as my 16-yr old dog has been alive and this hospital has gone too popular for the quality work the doctor does but has deteriorated in terms of logistics and customer service. Anyone with common sense should look at other great hospitals in the area. I highly suggest that this hospital invest in an appointment software platform or a good ‘ol appointment book and pen. Clearly the decision makers of this hospital choose not to. Great hospital but poor business logic. Prices are cheap which means they are clearly trying to see more pets to make money. How about slightly raising costs and changing to appointment-based?! I can assure your loyal customers will understand and continue to visit your hospital but will be much happier than miserably waiting for hours to be seen. Read between the lines and pay attention to the bad reviews more than the fluffy nice reviews. It is evident this hospital cares about our pets but are not making the necessary changes to maintain the quality service and care that they used to have. Best wishes to all patrons who are willing to wait unnecessarily. For this reason I have downgraded my review from 5-stars to 2-stars and sadly have ended my loyalty to this hospital.
